doc: Decisions about hook overlaps that tools/hook_map.py would otherwise report as errors (check redesign package A, docs/HISTORY.md section 4). Entry: rule (R1..R14 or a list), sites (GA ids / site keys the finding involves), owners (finding owners must be a subset), kind (mutex: never both active; alias: same hook seen twice; accepted: known and accepted), reason, decided (date), evidence (source lines / docs), optional downgrade:'warn' (report as warning instead of suppressing). An entry that matches no finding is reported as stale. Every entry needs reason, decided and evidence.

entries.reason: Both patch the 1EC890 entry (E9 + NOP, six bytes). sortie belongs to SAN14_CombatAI.dll; district_intercept (SAN14_Convenience.dll) installs only when SAN14_CombatAI.dll is not loaded, so the entry has exactly one writer at run time. (The sortie code is also compiled into the convenience DLL but prepare_sortie runs only under SPLIT_COMBAT.) tactic_priority's CALL row at 7EBBC4 only calls this entry; it has no byte overlap with either patch.
